extra.final_summary: The data has two main issues: (1) 'Dram' and 'Torgerson' in the 'island' column are likely misspellings of 'Dream' and 'Torgersen', but the user rejected the fix to normalize them; (2) two exact duplicate rows (9 and 22) were found but the user rejected their removal. Despite these, the analysis was run on the current version. The average bill length for Adelie penguins is 37.25 mm on Biscoe, 40.9 mm on Dram, 36.97 mm on Dream, 39.64 mm on Torgersen, and 35.9 mm on Torgerson. Note that 'Dram' and 'Torgerson' are not valid island names per the rules, so results for these may be unreliable.
